def attractiveness(N, markers, edges):
    graph = {i: [] for i in range(1, N+1)}
    for u, v in edges:
        graph[u].append(v)
        graph[v].append(u)
    queue = deque([1])
    visited = set()

    while queue:
        u = queue.popleft()
        visited.add(u)

            if v not in visited:
                queue.append(v)
        marker_counts[u] = max(
            marker_counts[u],
            markers[u - 1]
        )

            marker_counts[u] = max(

            )

                marker_counts[u] - marker_counts[v]))
